title: Choose the visual language
question: For the weather lookup, the atmospheric radar-station direction was selected by the creative process. You can keep it, pick an alternative, or ask for another round.

options.label: Atmospheric radar station
options.lineage: high-altitude weather maps and observation centers
options.thesis: The city becomes a living atmospheric field where color describes the real condition.
options.viewport: Search in the foreground over a pressure field; the result expands like a city radar reading.
options.risk: Visual energy needs discipline so metrics and controls stay immediate.

options.label: Oscilloscope bench
options.thesis: A weather reading as a signal observed on a precision bench.
options.case: Works well for data, but identifies climate context less quickly than radar.

options.label: Orbital navigation panel
options.thesis: Chromatic blocks guide each reading like a space route.
options.case: High futuristic recognition, but color coding would be less tied to the real condition.

canonCard.label: The category baseline
canonCard.thesis: A conventional forecast card, well executed.
canonCard.viewport: A simple search over a clear weather panel.
